descriptions.zh: 如果您已经通过资源目录搭建了企业的多账号体系结构，您可以使用资源目录的管理账号或委派管理员账号开通跨账号资源搜索，查看多个成员中的资源。关于资源目录的更多信息，请参见[资源目录概述](~~200506~~)。
descriptions.en: If you have created a resource directory for your enterprise, you can enable the cross-account resource search feature by using the management account of the resource directory or a delegated administrator account of Resource Center to view the resources of members in the resource directory. For more information about a resource directory, see [Resource Directory overview](~~200506~~).
